【原文 English Original】
Seven rockets from four countries are set to launch this week. Starship is set to attempt its most consequential mission yet, while Falcon 9 is set to launch a pair of classified payloads for the United States Space Force. The United Launch Alliance is scheduled to fly Vulcan on its return-to-flight mission, and Electron is set to reach a milestone 100th mission. Internationally, China and South Korea are set to launch an unknown payload and a demonstration mission, respectively. Falcon 9 | USSF-627 (“R-5”) The first launch of the week will feature Falcon 9 delivering a classified payload for the United States Space Force (USSF). The mission, designated USSF-627, was initially scheduled to launch on Sunday, Nov. 8. Falcon 9 is now set to take off from Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E) at Vandenberg Space Force Base (VSFB) on Monday, Nov. 9, at 7:07 PM PST (03:07 UTC on Nov. 10), four minutes into a window that extends until 11:03 PM PST (07:03 UTC on Nov. 10). Due to the classified nature of the payload, the exact quantity of satellites is unknown. Some indicators suggest a Starshield launch, based on drop zones for Falcon 9’s second stage. Starshield is a version of Starlink built for the United States government, with its primary customers being the USSF, National Reconnaissance Office, and the Space Development Agency. A Falcon 9 on the launch pad at Space Launch Complex-4E on Vandenberg Space Force Base. (Credit: SpaceX) Falcon 9 is a two-stage, 70 m-tall, partially reusable rocket that uses nine Merlin 1D sea-level engines on its first stage and a single vacuum-optimized Merlin 1D on its second stage. Falcon 9’s first stage lands either aboard an autonomous droneship or at a landing site, with its fairings being recovered and reused after flight. Both stages utilize liquid kerosene and liquid oxygen as propellants. Booster B1103 will be supporting this mission on its seventh flight. Previously, this booster has supported the launches of NROL-179, Tranche 1 Transport Layers A and E, and three Starlink missions. Falcon 9 will land downrange aboard SpaceX’s droneship Of Course I Still Love You . Mir | Demo Flight On Tuesday, Nov. 10, South Korea is set to launch the second flight of Mir, the South Korean military’s small satellite launch vehicle. This launch is set to be the first orbital flight of the full-scale rocket, following a test flight in December 2023 that did not include the second stage. The launch window opens at 05:00 UTC and extends until 09:00 UTC. Mir is a four-stage, solid-fuel launch vehicle with a liquid-fueled fourth stage for precise orbital insertion. The version that flew in December 2023 was capable of 700 kg to LEO, with this version suspected to be capable of around 1,000 kg. Chang Zheng 2D | Unknown Payload On Wednesday, Nov. 11, a Chang Zheng 2D (CZ-2D) rocket is scheduled to launch out of the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center. The launch is currently scheduled for 11:40 UTC, eight minutes into a window that opens at 11:32 UTC and extends until 12:05 UTC. CZ-2D will deliver an unknown payload into orbit. CZ-2D is a two-stage, 41 m-tall launch vehicle capable of delivering 3,500 kg to low-Earth orbit (LEO). CZ-2D’s first and second stages are both powered by dinitrogen tetroxide and unsymmetrical dimethyl hydrazine, both hypergolic propellants. Wednesday’s launch will be the 107th overall for CZ-2D, and sixth in 2026. Kuaizhou 11 | Unknown Payload The second and final scheduled Chinese mission of the week will see a Kuaizhou 11 rocket launch on Thursday, Nov. 12. Liftoff is set for 19:50 UTC from Site 95A at the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, during a 45-minute launch window. Kuaizhou 11 is a four-stage Chinese rocket manufactured by the China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation. Standing 25.3 m tall, the rocket can loft 1,500 kg to LEO with a liftoff thrust of 1,250 kN. This mission will be the eighth overall Kuaizhou 11 mission and the fourth of 2026. Vulcan VC6L | Amazon Leo (LV-01) United Launch Alliance’s (ULA) Vulcan rocket is set to launch on Friday, Nov. 13, from Space Launch Complex 41 (SLC-41) at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station. The 30-minute launch window opens at 12:54 PM EST (17:54 UTC). This will be the first flight of Vulcan in over nine months, following the ejection of one of Vulcan’s GEM-63XL solid rocket boosters at T+69 seconds on the USSF-87 mission. Flying aboard Vulcan will be a stack of 40 Amazon Leo satellites for Amazon’s Leo satellite internet constellation, a rival to SpaceX’s Starlink. A ULA Vulcan (USSF-87) sits next to a SpaceX Crew Dragon (Crew-12). (Credit: Tyler Gray for NSF) Vulcan is a two-stage launch vehicle with a range of launch configurations. Vulcan’s first stage is powered by two BE-4 engines built by Blue Origin, running on liquid methane and liquid oxygen propellants. Its second stage, Centaur V, is powered by twin RL10C engines running on liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen. Centaur V can be configured as Centaur LEO, High Energy, or Endurance. Vulcan can also be configured with solid rocket boosters to augment liftoff thrust, with options ranging from zero to two, four, or six boosters. The payload is encapsulated by either a short (15.5 m) or a long (21.3 m) fairing. Vulcan will debut the Vulcan VC6L variant, designated by six solid boosters and the long fairing option. Vulcan will debut the LEO-optimized Centaur V, which is 1.94 m smaller than the existing Centaur V High Energy, which has flown on all previous Vulcan launches. Additionally, this flight is a certification flight of this Vulcan configuration for the United States Space Force. Amazon Leo (LV-01) will be the first of 38 scheduled for Vulcan and the fifth overall mission for Vulcan. Starship | Flight 15 / Starlink Group 31-2 Pending regulatory approval, Starship is set to fly its next, and most significant, mission no earlier than Friday, Nov. 13, at 4:45 PM CST (22:45 UTC). The launch window extends until 6:00 PM CST (00:00 UTC on Nov. 14). Flight 15 will feature two notable events: the first booster-catch attempt since Flight 8, following stage separation, and the first attempt to catch the ship, roughly 22 hours after liftoff. Starship is a two-stage, super-heavy-lift launch vehicle capable of lofting an estimated 100 tonnes. The first stage, named Super Heavy, features 33 Raptor 3 engines, running off of liquid methane and liquid oxygen propellants. The second stage, named Starship, features six Raptor 3 engines, three sea-level and three vacuum-optimized, also running off of liquid methane and liquid oxygen. Flying on Flight 15 will be Ship 42 and Booster 22, both on their first flights. Flight 15 is expected to deliver 26 Starlink v3 satellites to LEO. Like Flight 14, three of these satellites will feature imaging capabilities for imaging the heat shield of Starship in orbit. Flight 15 will be the 15th full-stack launch of Starship and the fourth for the system’s V3 configuration. Falcon 9 | USSF-317 (“R-6”) Falcon 9 is set to fly again on Friday, Nov. 13, from VSFB with another USSF mission. The designation for this flight is USSF-317. The launch window opens at 8:09 PM PST (04:09 UTC on Nov. 14), and lasts for four hours. This mission will fly another unknown quantity of presumed Starshield satellites to LEO. Booster B1100 will support this mission, marking its 11th flight. This booster has previously supported NROL-105, USSF-385, and eight Starlink missions. B1100 will land downrange aboard SpaceX’s droneship Of Course I Still Love You . Electron during its 95th launch “Happily Ever Faster.” Credit: Rocket Lab) Electron | The Mountain God Rises The last scheduled launch of the week will see Rocket Lab’s Electron launch from the Mahia Peninsula in New Zealand on Saturday, Nov. 14, at 05:30 UTC. This flight of Electron, named “The Mountain God Rises,” will deliver another iQPS satellite into LEO for iQPS’s synthetic aperture radar constellation (SAR). SAR is used to image the surface of the Earth and can penetrate through cloud layers. Electron is a two-stage small-lift vehicle capable of delivering up to 300 kg to LEO and 200 kg to Sun-synchronous orbit. The vehicle is fueled by liquid kerosene and liquid oxygen, which powers nine Rutherford engines on the first stage and a single vacuum-optimized Rutherford on the second stage. This mission will serve as Electron’s 100th overall mission — a notable milestone for the small rocket that first flew in 2017. In addition, this mission will serve as the 269th orbital launch attempt worldwide in 2026. ( Lead Image: Falcon 9 launches from Florida. Credit: Julia Bergeron for NSF) The post Launch Preview: Starship, Vulcan, and Electron launches scheduled for busy week appeared first on NASASpaceFlight.com .

title: Rethinking the pipeline for critical defense electronics
zh_title: 重新思考关键国防电子产品的管道
summary: 军事需要近乎实时地应对新出现的威胁，这给新能力交付作战人员之前建立在漫长的研究、开发、测试和评估 (RDT&E) 周期之上的传统采购流程带来了压力。这一点在射频 (RF) 技术中最为明显，快速变化的电子战 (EW) 威胁、指挥和控制的新通信要求以及不断扩大的任务正在迫使国防工业基地在更短的时间内提供更多的能力。挑战不仅仅在于设计更快的处理器或更高的速度
content:
军事需要近乎实时地应对新出现的威胁，这给新能力交付作战人员之前建立在漫长的研究、开发、测试和评估 (RDT&E) 周期之上的传统采购流程带来了压力。这一点在射频 (RF) 技术中最为明显，快速变化的电子战 (EW) 威胁、指挥和控制的新通信要求以及不断扩大的任务正在迫使国防工业基地在更短的时间内提供更多的能力。

挑战不仅仅在于设计更快的处理器或更强大的射频放大器。例如，国防电子设备必须满足自主平台日益严格的尺寸、重量、功率和热限制，同时保持适应新的波形、频率和操作要求。与此同时，供应链限制和生产计划是这些系统到达作战人员手中的速度的决定因素。

对于向主要承包商供应电子产品的公司来说，答案越来越多地涉及采用经过验证的设计，而不是从头开始开发每项功能。这种方法降低了技术风险，缩短了资格认证时间，并且更容易将新功能集成到现有平台中。
Frontgrade Technologies [Frontgrade] 高级副总裁兼首席技术官 Lorne Graves 表示：“我们没有时间部署整个平台，回来看看会发生什么，然后再去做另一个。” “那些日子已经一去不复返了。”

**比传统获取更快地适应威胁**

如前所述，技术变革的步伐与开发、鉴定和生产军用电子产品所需的时间之间不匹配。对于电子战、战术通信、雷达和太空应用中使用的射频系统，在传统采集周期中，要求可能会发生很大变化。为一种威胁环境开发的架构在部署时可能需要适应不同的频率、波形或操作条件。

这使得适应性强的硬件和设计变得更加重要，这些硬件和设计允许在不更换整个子系统的情况下引入新功能。

“响应这些威胁所需的时间意味着你不会部署该平台，”格雷夫斯说。 “该架构最好具有适应性，能够改变和应对这些威胁。”
这种适应性并​​不是来自于针对每项需求追求高度定制的解决方案。相反，该解决方案越来越多地应用商业开发的功能和现有的合格设计，“以有效地获得足够好的解决方案，而无需创建非常定制的解决方案来满足非常有限的一组要求，”Frontgrade 高级副总裁兼首席增长官 Jack Kilian 说。

实际上，这可能意味着从已经满足 80% 的程序要求的设计开始，然后调整特定的功能、接口或性能特征。 Kilian 表示，它还可能涉及通过“相似性”进行鉴定，利用现有设计的证据来减少相关配置所需的测试。

对于军方来说，其优势不仅仅是缩短采购时间，因为它有助于更​​快地将演进的能力引入战场，同时为威胁变化时的后续升级保留路径。

采用经过验证的设计来满足需求，加快您的速度

【原文 English Original】
Military necessity to respond to emerging threats in near-real time is putting pressure on a traditional acquisition process built on lengthy Research, Development, Test, and Evaluation (RDT&E) cycles before a new capability can pass to warfighters. Nowhere is that more apparent than in radio frequency (RF) technology, where rapidly changing electronic warfare (EW) threats, new communications requirements for command and control, and expanding missions are forcing the defense industrial base to deliver more capability in less time.

The challenge extends beyond designing faster processors or more powerful RF amplifiers. Defense electronics must meet increasingly demanding size, weight, power, and thermal constraints for autonomous platforms, for example, while remaining adaptable to new waveforms, frequencies, and operational requirements. At the same time, supply-chain limitations and production schedules are the determining factor in how quickly those systems reach the warfighter.

For companies supplying electronics to prime contractors, the answer increasingly involves adapting proven designs rather than developing every capability from scratch. That approach reduces technical risk, shortens qualification timelines, and makes it easier to integrate new functionality into existing platforms.

“We don’t have time to field an entire platform, come back, see what happens, go do another one,” said Lorne Graves, senior vice president and chief technology officer at Frontgrade Technologies [Frontgrade]. “Those days are gone.”

**Adapting to threats faster than traditional acquisition allows**

As mentioned, there’s a mismatch between the pace of technological change and the time required to develop, qualify, and produce military electronics. For RF systems used in EW, tactical communications, radar, and space applications, requirements can change considerably during a traditional acquisition cycle. An architecture developed for one threat environment may need to accommodate different frequencies, waveforms, or operating conditions by the time it is fielded.

That puts a premium on adaptable hardware and designs that allow new capabilities to be introduced without replacing an entire subsystem.

“The time it takes to respond to these threats means that you wouldn’t field the platform,” said Graves. “The architecture better have adaptability to be able to change and counter those threats.”

Such adaptability doesn’t come from pursuing highly customized solutions for every requirement. Rather, the solution is increasingly the application of commercially developed capabilities and existing qualified designs “to effectively get a good enough solution without having to create a very bespoke solution to meet a very narrow set of requirements,” said Jack Kilian, senior vice president and chief growth officer for Frontgrade.

In practice, that could mean beginning with a design that already meets 80 percent of a program’s requirements, then adapting particular functions, interfaces, or performance characteristics. It could also involve qualification by “similarity”, using evidence from an existing design to reduce the testing needed for a related configuration, according to Kilian.

For the military, the advantage is not simply a shorter procurement timeline as it facilitates the bringing of evolved capabilities to the field sooner while preserving a path for subsequent upgrades as the threat changes.

Adapting proven designs to meet needs speeds up the delivery timeline for new technologies. (Photo illustration courtesy of Frontgrade.)

**Supply chain resilience becomes part of the mission**

The same emphasis on speed is changing how electronics suppliers manage manufacturing capacity. RF systems depend on specialized semiconductors, materials, and mechanical components that can be difficult to source. Gallium nitride, widely used in high-performance RF applications, illustrates the challenge because of supply-chain exposure involving the raw gallium required for its production.

Kilian noted the concentration of gallium production in China and the export restrictions that have increased concerns about access to critical materials. Bearings, magnets, and other components can also create lengthy production delays.

Frontgrade is addressing those risks through multiple sourcing, strategic inventories of critical parts, and greater internal manufacturing capability. The company is qualifying additional suppliers to reduce dependence on individual manufacturers, and maintaining stocks of components used across multiple product lines so production teams can respond more quickly without committing inventory to a single, specialized design. Standardizing certain components across products can substantially shorten delivery schedules.

“It can significantly pull in these lead times from beyond 52 weeks to below 26 weeks in many cases for these deliverables,” said Kilian. That means, for example, that Frontgrade can get critical hardware and electronics into a prime contractor’s hands for integration onto a communications satellite.

**Integrating the electronics backbone**

Frontgrade’s advanced RF capabilities have expanded through the addition of Aethercomm (acquired in 2023), IDSI (the Defense Solutions division of Crescend Technologies acquired in 2025), and Tricom Research (2025), complementing its existing portfolio of antennas, radiation-hardened electronics, processing, and power technologies.

Together, those capabilities cover a substantial portion of the signal chain from RF signal acquisition and conditioning through conversion, digital processing, and storage – whether they be individual components or larger integrated systems.

“Our prime customers are looking for partners that can effectively deliver integrated subsystem solutions that are ready to layer their application software on top of it,” said Kilian, noting in that arrangement that suppliers like Frontgrade can deliver hardware together with the middleware and application programming interfaces needed to support higher-level software integration.

Customers can purchase components to build their own boards, obtain board-level subsystems, or use more complete integrated systems that already combine RF, digital conversion, processing, and storage. The objective is to let prime contractors concentrate on the application and mission requirements rather than having to integrate every underlying electronic component themselves.

For military users, the implications extend across multiple mission areas. EW, radar, SATCOM, and counter-UAS systems operate across different frequency bands, but they share the need for efficient RF amplification, signal conditioning, and reliable performance under demanding environmental conditions.

The company’s acquired RF capabilities from the acquisitions mentioned above include technologies with a storied history in counter-improvised explosive device (IED) systems dating to the early 2000s – particularly the Counter Radio-Controlled Improvised Explosive Device Electronic Warfare (CREW) system that jammed RF signals that set off IEDs. That heritage also informs applications involving counter-UAS and other EW missions.

Another important requirement for today’s military electronics is delivering greater RF power from smaller packages while controlling thermal loads. Frontgrade provides efficient power amplifiers for small spaces that operate in high-thermal environments. Those attributes’ constraints are especially significant in space, where spacecraft cannot rely on the cooling approaches commonly available in terrestrial data centers and communications facilities.

The result is an engineering tradeoff in which power output, efficiency, packaging, and thermal performance is considered together rather than optimized independently.

**Building adaptability into the hardware**

The next step is making RF electronics easier to modify after the initial system design has been completed. Graves distinguishes between scalability, which generally involves expanding an existing capability, and extensibility, which allows proven technology to be adapted for different operating environments and mission requirements.

Common design elements developed for space, counter-UAS, and EW applications can serve as starting points for related systems. Using previously qualified modules can reduce development effort and enable suppliers to meet more demanding deployment schedules.

For example, that philosophy informs the design of Frontgrade’s power amplifiers. Rather than treating an amplifier as fixed hardware with a single operating configuration, Frontgrade is incorporating telemetry, health monitoring, and software-controlled features that allow performance to be adjusted to changing requirements. Those features support changes in power efficiency and waveform characteristics without necessarily requiring a hardware replacement.

Graves described these devices as “smart” power amplifiers, with controls intended to make the RF chain more responsive to operational requirements. The distinction becomes critical for equipment deployed in space as physical access to satellites is generally unavailable, making software adaptability considerably more important.

With having software-controlled RF capabilities, operators can adapt to interference and maintain communications links needed to deliver information to warfighters. The goal is to preserve the usefulness of existing hardware as threats and mission requirements evolve rather than treating every new requirement as a reason to redesign the system.

新加坡——专家告诉 Breaking Defense，澳大利亚军队最近成立的[沿海机动大队](https://www.defence.gov.au/news-events/releases/2026-03-30/new-littoral-manoeuvre-group-builted-brisbane)对于该国武装部队来说是正确的举动，特别是在印太地区紧张局势持续存在的情况下。

澳大利亚在其[2024年国防战略](https://www.defence.gov.au/about/strategic-planning/2024-national-defence-strategy-2024-integrated-investment-program)中宣布了将其地面部队转变为一支以沿海为重点的部队的计划，其中呼吁军队“针对沿海机动进行优化，具有远程陆地和海上打击能力”。

今年三月，澳大利亚陆军成立了濒海机动大队，以加强该军种“在沿海和岛屿地区调动、部署和支持地面部队的能力”。

但随着[一些项目的预算削减迫在眉睫](https://thenightly.com.au/politics/defence-budget-cuts-loom-as-aukus-funding-Pressure-drives-review-of-military-spending-c-23076920)为AUKUS支出腾出空间，专家警告说，该单位需要充足的资源，以确保其能够履行这一职责。
在三边协议承诺支出增加之后，该国正在进行预算审查，以腾出资金用于采购核潜艇，尽管该国承诺将国防支出提高到[国内生产总值的百分之三]产品](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/04/australia-pledges-to-boost-defense-spend-to-3-of-gdp-says-us-remains-key-partner/) 在未来几年。

上个月，濒海机动大队在与印度尼西亚的一次训练活动中完成了大规模两栖演习。

澳大利亚国立大学国际安全与情报研究教授约翰·布拉克斯兰（John Blaxland）告诉《突破防务》，这样的演习表明澳大利亚设想与盟友和伙伴合作部署部队来观察和保护关键的沿海地点，并在冲突中控制海上咽喉要道。

布莱克斯兰说：“濒海机动大队是澳大利亚的一个激进的组织设计概念，反映了对能够快速部署和支持与伙伴一起远距离作战的部队的重大重新定位。”他补充说，该大队可以追溯到第二次世界大战，当时澳大利亚军队展示了对沿海联合兵种作战的掌握。

澳大利亚独立海军评论员亚历克斯·勒克（Alex Luck）对此表示同意，称关注沿海行动是“朝着正确方向迈出的一步”。
“鉴于中国军事能力不断增强，扩展到更广阔的太平洋和印度洋战区，澳大利亚在其周边地区面临着严峻的地理挑战。因此，澳大利亚陆军将不得不依赖强大的海军机动能力，以灵活覆盖包括澳大利亚直接控制的岛屿和澳大利亚领土周围的海上通道在内的海域，”他补充道。

他还强调需要与美国和新西兰等澳大利亚邻国和合作伙伴合作，“确保澳大利亚周围的海洋特征，特别是太平洋岛屿空间的安全。”

濒海机动大队将包括三个登陆艇营，每个营拥有四艘中型登陆艇和两艘重型登陆艇。布拉克斯兰和拉克都同意为该小组配备这些登陆艇至关重要。

澳大利亚向 Austal Aust 授予合同

【原文 English Original】
SINGAPORE — The Australian army’s recently created [Littoral Manoeuvre Group](https://www.defence.gov.au/news-events/releases/2026-03-30/new-littoral-manoeuvre-group-established-brisbane)is the correct move for the country’s armed forces, experts told Breaking Defense, especially as tensions continue in the Indo-Pacific.

Australia announced plans to transform its ground forces into a littoral-focused force in its [2024 National Defence Strategy](https://www.defence.gov.au/about/strategic-planning/2024-national-defence-strategy-2024-integrated-investment-program), which called for an army “optimised for littoral manoeuvre with a long range land and maritime strike capability.”

In March, Australian Army established the Littoral Manoeuvre Group to strengthen the service’s “ability to move, deploy and support land forces across coastal and island regions.”

But as[budget cuts to some programs loom](https://thenightly.com.au/politics/defence-budget-cuts-loom-as-aukus-funding-pressure-drives-review-of-military-spending-c-23076920)to make room for AUKUS spending, experts warn that the unit needs to be adequately resourced to ensure it can fulfil that role.

In the wake of increased spending on commitments for the trilateral agreement, the country is conducting a budget review to free up funds for the acquisition of nuclear submarines, even as the country is pledging to bring defense spending up to [three percent of its gross domestic product](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/04/australia-pledges-to-boost-defense-spend-to-3-of-gdp-says-us-remains-key-partner/) in the coming years.

Last month, the Littoral Manoeuvre Group completed a large-scale amphibious exercise during a training event with Indonesia.

John Blaxland,a professor of international security and intelligence studies at Australian National University, told Breaking Defense that an exercis e like that suggests that Australia envisages working with allies and partners to deploy forces to observe and safeguard key littoral sites, as well as control maritime chokepoints in a conflict.

“The Littoral Manoeuvre Group is a radical organisational design concept for Australia which reflects a significant reorientation towards being able to rapidly deploy and support forces operating over considerable distances alongside partners,” Blaxland said, adding that the group harks back to World War II, when Australian forces demonstrated mastery of combined arms warfare in the littorals.

Independent Australian naval commentator Alex Luck agreed, calling the focus on littoral operations “a step in the right direction.”

“Australia faces a difficult geographic challenge in its near abroad, in light of a rising Chinese military capability expanding into the wider Pacific and Indian Ocean theatres. Therefore the Australian Army will have to rely on significant naval mobility allowing for flexible coverage of maritime spaces including islands directly under Australian control and maritime approaches around Australian territory,” he added.

He also stressed the need to work with Australia’s neighbors and partners such as the US and New Zealand “in securing maritime features around Australia, but particularly across Pacific Island spaces.”

The Littoral Manoeuvre Group will include three landing craft battalions, each operating four medium and two heavy landing craft. Both Blaxland and Luck agree that outfitting the group with these landing craft is crucial.

Australia awarded contracts to Austal Australia for [Land Craft Medium](https://breakingdefense.com/2025/12/austal-defence-australia-awarded-681-million-landing-craft-contract-down-under/) in December 2025 and for [Landing Craft Heavy](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/02/austal-secures-second-australian-landing-craft-heavy-contract/) in February. LCM will have a cargo capacity of 80 tonnes (88 tons) while the LCH will be able to transport 200 soldiers and six M1 Abrams tanks or nine Redback infantry vehicles.

Luck said the introduction of the two new classes of landing craft would introduce capabilities that the Australian Army has not operated in recent times.

“The LCH in particular, in conjunction with the Royal Australian Navy’s own amphibious assets, represents an unprecedented new resource the Australian Army will need time to further refine and develo p,” he said.

“It is therefore important to apply a step by step approach maturing these new amphibious capabilities to allow for further refinement, including allocation of additional resources further strengthening the new LMG concept,” he continued.

And while Australia’s plans to equip the new group as outlined in Australia’s defense [Integrated Investment Program](https://www.defence.gov.au/about/strategic-planning/2026-national-defence-strategy-2026-integrated-investment-program) appear to be sufficient, Blaxland cautioned that those plans would take time to come to fruition and was dependent on whether funding is available to follow through.

“The plan appears to be to expand significantly to help move whole battalion groups and supporting elements to work alongside partner forces in the ‘littorals’ across the archipelago. But with significant funding constraints, this is not likely to reach full operational capacity for some years yet,” he said.

title: Elon Musk says it ‘would be an honor’ to hire ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
zh_title: 埃隆·马斯克表示，能够聘请被罢免的英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋“将是一种荣幸”
summary: 黄仁勋在情报来源披露他与一名疑似中国间谍的关系两周后，以及他与英伟达副总裁的恋情曝光一天后，辞去了英伟达首席执行官的职务。 But hours before this move, when it was just rumored that the Nvidia board was planning to oust him , Elon Musk had already stated his willingness to hire the former Nvidia chief on X . A random X user posted, “Elon please hire Jensen,” to which the billionaire replied, “That would be an honor.” @zerohedge That would be an honor November 12, 2026 Despite the scandals that Jensen is
content:
黄仁勋在情报来源披露他与一名疑似中国间谍的关系两周后，以及他与英伟达副总裁的恋情曝光一天后，辞去了英伟达首席执行官的职务。但在此举之前几个小时，当有传言称 Nvidia 董事会计划将他驱逐时，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 就已经表示愿意聘用这位 Nvidia 前首席执行官。一位随机的 X 用户发帖称，“埃隆请雇用詹森”，这位亿万富翁回答道：“那将是一种荣幸。” @zerohedge 这将是一种荣誉，2026 年 11 月 12 日 尽管 Jensen 目前面临丑闻，但他仍然拥有工程专业知识、对行业及其内部运作的深入了解，再加上在世界各地的多重联系，这对于任何想要进入半导体行业的公司来说都是极其有价值的。这正是埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 在他的 Terafab 项目中所做的事情，他于 2025 年 11 月首次提到该项目。黄仁勋甚至警告说，这将是一个挑战，并指出“台积电谋生的工程、科学和艺术是极其困难的。”尽管如此，马斯克仍将资源投入到该项目中，Terafab 工厂的建设正如火如荼地进行，并计划在 2028 年下半年实现芯片量产。马斯克本人表示，该工厂的目标是到 2032 年实现每月 100 万片晶圆的产能。
特斯拉有着雄心勃勃的人工智能加速器路线图，SpaceX 甚至宣称在未来制造自己的 GPU。我们仍然不知道黄仁勋的计划是什么，但尽管他不再是 Nvidia 董事会及其领导层的成员，Jensen 和他的妻子 Lori 仍然通过各种信托和有限责任公司共同持有约 8 亿股 Nvidia 股票，而黄仁勋本人则拥有约 7000 万股 Nvidia 股票。除此之外，他仍然收到国会发出的讨论英伟达安全协议的邀请，如果他拒绝的话，这可能会变成传票，尽管我们不知道他的辞职会对闭门会议产生什么影响。据报道，FBI 正在调查他与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 的关系，后者据称在向中国进口价值 75 亿美元的 Nvidia AI GPU 过程中发挥了重要作用，并涉嫌与中国国家安全部合作。黄仁勋只是因与下属发生关系或外遇而辞职或被免职的高管名单中最新的一个。其中包括2005年的波音前首席执行官哈里·斯通西弗(Harry Stonecipher)、2010年的惠普首席执行官马克·赫德(Mark Hurd)、2018年的英特尔首席执行官布莱恩·科兹安尼克(Brian Krzanich)和2019年的前麦当劳首席执行官史蒂夫·伊斯特布鲁克(Steve Easterbrook)。
据了解，马斯克本人与多家公司的下属有过关系，他甚至通过试管受精与 2017 年开始在特斯拉工作的 Neuralink 高管 Shivon Zilis 生了四个孩子。目前尚不清楚马斯克的回复是否是对黄仁勋的认真报价。但如果这位前 Nvidia 首席执行官决定为 Musk 的 Terafab 项目工作，那么 Jensen 可以利用他的努力和专业知识，将其变成 Nvidia 的强大竞争对手。

【原文 English Original】
Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO two weeks after his relationship with a suspected Chinese spy was revealed by intelligence sources and a day after his affair with an Nvidia vice president became publicly known. But hours before this move, when it was just rumored that the Nvidia board was planning to oust him , Elon Musk had already stated his willingness to hire the former Nvidia chief on X . A random X user posted, “Elon please hire Jensen,” to which the billionaire replied, “That would be an honor.” @zerohedge That would be an honor November 12, 2026 Despite the scandals that Jensen is currently facing, he still has the engineering know-how, deep knowledge of the industry and its inner workings, plus multiple connections across the world, which would be extremely valuable for any company looking to break into the semiconductor industry. This is exactly what Elon Musk is doing with his Terafab project, which he first mentioned in November 2025 . Jensen Huang even warned that this was going to be a challenge, pointing out that “the engineering, the science, and the artistry of doing what TSMC does for a living is extremely hard.” Nevertheless, Musk poured his resources into the project, with construction on the Terafab facility in full swing and with plans to hit volume chip production by the second half of 2028 . Musk himself said that the site targets a production capacity of a million wafers a month by 2032. Tesla has an ambitious AI accelerator roadmap , and SpaceX has even touted making its own GPUs in the future . We still don’t know what Jensen Huang’s plans are, but even though he’s no longer a part of the Nvidia board and its leadership, Jensen and his wife, Lori, still jointly own approximately 800 million Nvidia shares through various trusts and LLCs, while Huang himself personally owns around 70 million Nvidia shares. Aside from that, he still has an outstanding invitation from Congress to discuss Nvidia’s security protocols, which could turn into a subpoena if he snubs them, although we don’t know how his resignation would affect the closed-door meeting. There’s also a reported FBI investigation into his relationship with Alice Huang , the Megaspeed executive who was allegedly instrumental in the import of $7.5 billion worth of Nvidia AI GPUs into China and is suspected of working with China’s Ministry of State Security . Jensen Huang is just the latest in the long list of executives who resigned or were ousted from their leadership position because of a relationship or an affair with a subordinate. This includes former Boeing CEO Harry Stonecipher in 2005, HP CEO Mark Hurd in 2010, Intel CEO Brian Krzanich in 2018, and former McDonald’s CEO Steve Easterbrook in 2019. Musk himself is known to have had relationships with subordinates from his various companies, and that he has even fathered four children with Shivon Zilis, a top executive at Neuralink who started working at Tesla in 2017, through IVF. It’s still not confirmed if Musk’s reply is a serious offer for Jensen Huang. But if the former Nvidia chief ever decides to work for Musk on his Terafab project, then Jensen could put his effort and expertise into turning it into a formidable competitor to Nvidia.

title: President Trump says Apple’s Tim Cook is the only man to replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO
zh_title: 特朗普总统表示，苹果公司的蒂姆·库克是唯一接替黄仁勋出任英伟达首席执行官的人
summary: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，退休的苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克应该接替黄仁勋担任英伟达首席执行官，就在黄仁勋因一系列丑闻而辞职的消息宣布几小时后。总统在他的真相社交平台上表示，“现在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋已经辞职，他的工作非常出色，只有一个人可以接替他的位置——苹果公司的蒂姆·库克。传奇取代传奇！总统唐纳德·J·特朗普。”英伟达董事会周三宣布，因婚外情被曝光，黄仁勋已辞职
content:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，退休的苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克应该接替黄仁勋担任英伟达首席执行官，就在黄仁勋因一系列丑闻而辞职的消息宣布几小时后。总统在他的真相社交平台上表示，“现在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋已经辞职，他的工作非常出色，只有一个人可以接替他的位置——苹果公司的蒂姆·库克。传奇取代传奇！总统唐纳德·J·特朗普。”英伟达董事会周三宣布，黄仁勋因与一名涉嫌中国情报人员的 Megaspeed 高管发生婚外情以及与英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 发生婚外情而辞职。执行副总裁兼首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 将在公司寻找替代者期间担任临时首席执行官。当然，潜在的继任者候选人的名字已经浮出水面，其中包括苹果首席硬件官约翰尼·斯鲁吉(Johny Srouji)。由于英伟达处于全球人工智能爆发的中心，黄仁勋和特朗普的关系密切，经常成为新闻头条。特朗普此前曾形容黄仁勋对于关税和废除拜登总统的人工智能扩散规则的看法“非常有远见”。正在发生的黄事件丑闻中提到了特朗普总统的名字。值得注意的是，据称，虽然美国
情报认为黄仁勋是中国蜜罐行动的目标，有报道称特朗普总统已听取了此事的简报，但选择不对这些信息采取任何行动，以免影响英伟达的销售或与中国对抗。国会已传唤黄仁勋出席中共特别委员会，议员们威胁如果黄仁勋不同意自愿参加闭门会议，将向他发出传票。蒂姆·库克目前担任苹果公司董事会执行主席，曾于 2011 年至 2026 年担任该公司首席执行官。在他任职期间，他负责监督 Apple Music 和 Apple TV 等众多 Apple 服务的推出，同时扩展到 Apple Watch 和 AirPods 等新产品类别。周三开盘时，英伟达股价暴跌超过 10 个百分点，但由于交易员希望利用英伟达股价下跌的机会，该公司股价收复了大部分失地。该公司将于下周（即 11 月 17 日星期二）公布 2027 财年第三季度财务业绩。

【原文 English Original】
President Donald Trump has said that retired Apple CEO Tim Cook should replace Jensen Huang as the CEO of Nvidia, just hours after it was announced that the latter had resigned in the wake of a series of scandals. Taking to his Truth Social platform, the President said , "NOW THAT Nvidia CEO JENSEN HUANG, who has done a fantastic job, has resigned, there is only one man to take his place - TIM COOK of Apple. A Legend replaces a Legend! President DONALD J. TRUMP." Nvidia's board of directors announced on Wednesday that Huang had resigned following the revelation that he conducted an extramarital affair with a Megaspeed executive suspected of being a Chinese intelligence asset , and a further affair with Nvidia Vice President of Health Care, Kimberly Powell. Colette Kress, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will serve as Interim CEO while the company looks for a replacement. Naturally, names have been floated as potential successor candidates, including Apple's Chief Hardware Officer Johny Srouji. With Nvidia at the center of the global explosion in AI, Huang and Trump have enjoyed a close relationship that routinely makes news headlines. Trump previously described Huang as 'utterly visionary' in regard to his views on tariffs and rescinding President Biden's AI Diffusion Rule . President Trump's name has been mentioned in the ongoing Huang affair scandal. Notably, it is alleged that while U.S. intelligence believed that Huang had been the target of a Chinese honeypot operation , reports claim that President Trump was briefed on the matter but chose not to do anything with the information, so as not to affect Nvidia's sales or antagonize China. Congress has summoned Jensen Huang to appear before the Select Committee on the CCP , with lawmakers threatening to issue Huang with a subpoena if he doesn't agree to attend a closed-door meeting voluntarily. Tim Cook is currently the Executive Chair of Apple's board, having served as the company's CEO from 2011 to 2026. During his tenure, he oversaw the launch of a plethora of Apple services, including Apple Music and Apple TV, while expanding into new product categories such as Apple Watch and AirPods. Nvidia's share price plunged more than 10 percentage points at the open on Wednesday, but recovered much of that ground as traders looked to take advantage of the dip in Nvidia's share price. The company will report its third-quarter fiscal 2027 financial results next week, on Tuesday, November 17.

content:
黄爱丽因间谍指控八次进入台湾 |海峡时报
被指控监视英伟达首席执行官的中国女性黄爱丽 (Alice Huang) 曾八次进入台湾
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
2025 年 5 月，台北顶级科技博览会台北国际电脑展期间，黄仁勋在台北一家中餐厅举办晚宴，有人看到爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 出席。
发表于 2026 年 11 月 12 日 12:53
更新于 2026 年 11 月 12 日 1:45
台湾方面表示，黄丽娟在2024年和2025年期间曾八次到访。陆委会主任邱垂正表示，她以普通商务旅客身份持香港护照入境。
该案与黄乐（又名黄乐）在与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋有染期间为北京从事间谍活动的指控有关。北京否认间谍指控。
台湾安全部门正在调查。邱说，官员们没有收到美国的警告，如果他们发现任何威胁，他们将加强检查。
台北——台湾政府部长 11 月 12 日表示，这名被指控在与英伟达创始人黄仁勋有染期间为北京从事间谍活动的女子在 2024 年和 2025 年总共访问台湾八次。
台湾是全球半导体行业的主导者，处于美国和中国之间战略竞争的中心，中国声称这个自治岛屿是其领土的一部分。
美国芯片巨头英伟达 (Nvidia) 首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 承认自己与新加坡公司 Megaspeed 前高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 有婚外情，美国官员认为她为中国情报部门工作。
北京否认了间谍指控。
陆委会主任邱垂正告诉国会议员，黄丽娟（又名黄乐）使用香港护照“以标准商务访客身份”进入台湾，当时她“没有特殊标志”。
邱在台湾立法院回应议员有关黄丽娟入境台湾的质询，以及《纽约时报》报道美国早在2024年就建议台湾监控她的行踪时发表上述言论。
“至少我们陆委会没有收到任何相关信息，”邱说。

TAIPEI – The woman accused of spying for Beijing during an affair with Nvidia founder Jensen Huang visited Taiwan a total of eight times in 2024 and 2025, a Taiwanese government minister said on Nov 12.
Taiwan, a dominant player in the global semiconductor industry, sits at the centre of strategic competition between the United States and China, which claims the self-ruled island as part of its territory.
Jensen Huang, chief executive of the US-based chip giant Nvidia, has admitted to having an extramarital affair, reportedly with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based company Megaspeed who US officials believe was working for Chinese intelligence.
Beijing has rejected the spying allegations.

习近平表示，台湾与中国的“完全统一”必须实现，称这是“坚定不移的历史使命”，并表示北京希望“和平统一”。
他将此与孙中山的遗产联系起来，敦促所有中国人反对台湾独立并支持两岸关系，而台湾则拒绝了北京的主张。
这篇讲话是在亚太经合组织峰会和台湾地方选举之前发表的，当时紧张局势持续高涨，而且中国在台湾周围保持军事压力。
北京—中国国家主席习近平11月12日表示，历史的潮流不可阻挡，他敦促台湾与祖国完全“统一”，并承诺以和平方式实现统一，没有提及使用武力。
中国将民主治理的台湾视为自己的领土，尽管台北强烈反对这一说法，并一再提出“一个国家，两种制度”的自治模式，但没有得到任何主要台湾政党的支持。
习近平在北京人民大会堂发表讲话时表示，解决台湾问题是中国共产党坚定不移的历史使命。
“历史的潮流无法阻挡，”他补充道。 “祖国的完全统一一定能够实现，也一定能够实现。”
台湾政府认为这些言论不是什么新鲜事。
“至于台湾统一的措辞，与过去没有太大不同，”台湾陆委会发言人梁文杰表示。
习近平是在革命英雄孙中山诞辰 160 周年之际发表讲话时发表上述言论的。孙中山于 1911 年领导了一场起义，结束了几个世纪的皇帝和皇后统治，迎来了中华民国。
习近平表示，中国坚持“和平统一和‘一国两制’政策”，愿意在坚持“一个中国原则”或北京海峡两岸是一个国家的立场的同时与台湾对话。
包括台湾同胞在内的全中国人民要携起手来，共同反对台独“分裂”势力，推动两岸关系和平发展。
尽管习近平没有提及对台湾使用武力（中国从未放弃对台湾使用武力），但中国军队每天都在台湾周边开展行动，并将触角进一步延伸到太平洋。
台湾国防部表示，从11月12日开始，发现包括J-16战斗机和无人机在内的29架中国军用飞机与中国军舰一起在台湾周围进行“联合战备巡逻”。
台湾呼吁民众远离中国事件
习近平的讲话是在中国南部科技中心深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会前一周发表的，他将在深圳再次会见美国总统唐纳德·特朗普，距离台湾重要的地方选举还有两周多一点。
10月，台湾呼吁民众避开中国纪念孙中山纪念日的任何活动，称中国对孙中山及其遗产的看法是扭曲的。

China’s Xi says Taiwan ‘reunification’ must happen as tide of history cannot be stopped

Chinese President Xi Jinping did not mention the use of force, which China has never renounced for Taiwan.
Published Nov 12, 2026, 12:18 PM
Updated Nov 12, 2026, 06:00 PM
Xi Jinping said Taiwan’s “complete reunification” with China must happen, calling it an “unwavering historical mission” and saying Beijing wants “peaceful reunification”.
He linked this to Sun Yat-sen’s legacy, urging all Chinese to oppose Taiwan independence and support cross-Strait ties, while Taiwan rejected Beijing’s claim.
The speech came before the APEC summit and Taiwan local elections, as tensions stay high and China keeps military pressure around the island.
BEIJING – The tide of history cannot be stopped, Chinese President Xi Jinping said on Nov 12, as he urged complete “reunification” of Taiwan with the motherland and pledged to do so peacefully, making no mention of the use of force.
China views democratically governed Taiwan as its own territory, despite Taipei’s strong rejection of that claim, and has repeatedly offered a “one country, two systems” model of autonomy not supported by any major Taiwanese political party.
Resolving the Taiwan question is an “unwavering historical mission” of the Communist Party of China, Xi said in a speech at Beijing’s Great Hall of the People.
“The tide of history cannot be stopped,” he added. “The complete reunification of the motherland must be realised, and it will certainly be realised.”
Taiwan’s government dismissed the remarks as nothing new.
“As for the wording on Taiwan unification, it isn’t much different from the past,” said Liang Wen-chieh, spokesman for Taiwan’s Mainland Affairs Council.
Xi’s comments came in a speech on the 160th birthday of revolutionary hero Sun Yat-sen, who helped lead a 1911 revolt that ended centuries of rule by emperors and empresses and ushered in the Republic of China.
Xi said China adheres to “peaceful reunification and the policy of ‘one country, two systems’” and is willing to talk to Taiwan while upholding the “one-China principle”, or Beijing’s position that both sides of the Taiwan Strait are one country.
All Chinese, including those in Taiwan, should join hands to jointly oppose Taiwan independence “separatist” forces and strive for peaceful development of cross-Strait ties, Xi added.
Despite Xi not mentioning the use of force, which China has never renounced for Taiwan, its military operates around the island daily, and is extending its reach farther into the Pacific.
Taiwan’s Defence Ministry said it had detected 29 Chinese military aircraft, including J-16 fighter jets and drones, carrying out a “joint combat readiness patrol” around Taiwan in conjunction with Chinese warships, starting on Nov 12.
Taiwan tells people to stay away from China events
Xi’s speech comes a week ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in China’s southern technology hub of Shenzhen, where he is due to again meet US President Donald Trump, and also a little more than two weeks before important local elections in Taiwan.
In October, Taiwan called on its people to steer clear of any of China’s events to mark the Sun anniversary, saying that China had a distorted view of Sun and his legacy.
Beijing calls Sun a great national hero and patriot, as well as the forerunner of the 1949 communist revolution that forced the defeated Republic of China government to flee to Taiwan, where it remains to this day.
Xi said Sun was a great national hero, a great patriot and a “great pioneer of China’s democratic revolution”.
“Mr Sun Yat-sen consistently upheld the unity of the country and the solidarity of the nation, and he firmly opposed all words and actions that split the country or the nation,” he added.
In Taiwan, Sun is officially considered the “father of the nation” and his portrait hangs in the presidential office, though his political philosophy, Three Principles Of The People, is no longer a required text for schoolchildren.
While Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te and his ruling Democratic Progressive Party champion Taiwan’s separate identity from China, they have been striking a tougher tone with Beijing on the role of the Republic of China.
Taiwan has been particularly upset by Beijing’s effort to claim credit for the victory in World War II, saying it was the Republic of China government that fought alongside the allies, as the People’s Republic of China did not exist at the time.
China says Lai is a “separatist” and has refused to speak with him. Lai says only Taiwan’s people can decide their future. REUTERS

黎智英表示，亚太经合组织是一个重要的贸易论坛，并要求特使施振荣强调台湾在地缘政治、能源问题和供应链变化中是一支“稳定和值得信赖的力量”。
中国表示，根据“一个中国原则”，台湾可以“照常”参加，但由于北京拒绝与赖清德对话，并对台湾继续施加军事压力，紧张局势依然严重。
台北 — — 台湾总统赖清德 11 月 12 日表示，台湾将本着“平等”互动的原则，参加在中国举行的 2026 年亚太经合组织 (APEC) 领导人峰会，此前台湾政府要求北京方面为此提供书面保证。
亚太经合组织是少数几个包括台湾在内的国际机构之一，中国视台湾为自己的领土。中国是 2026 年的东道主，领导人峰会下周将在南方城市深圳举行。
然而，台北和北京之间的关系极其紧张。中国拒绝与黎智英对话，称他是“分裂分子”，而且中国军队每天都在该岛周围活动。赖拒绝北京的主权主张。
黎智英在台北总统府介绍电脑制造商宏碁创始人施振荣担任峰会特使时表示，亚太经合组织是该地区最重要的贸易和经济合作多边机制。
他补充说：“所有成员都在平等的基础上互动，台湾也本着同样的原则参加今年的亚太经合组织会议。”
“我要感谢许多志同道合的国家，在筹备APEC会议期间，一直强调台湾参与所有会议的重要性，”赖说，但没有点名任何国家。
中国外交部11月11日晚表示，“按照一个中国原则和APEC相关谅解备忘录的规则和惯例”处理“台湾地区”参加APEC。
“只要遵循这些做法，台湾地区的代表就可以正常参加会议，”它补充道。
黎智英表示，他希望施政在峰会上传达几个信息，包括在全球经济面临地缘政治、能源和供应链重组的挑战时，台湾将继续充当稳定和值得信赖的力量。
他补充说，台湾将深化与主要伙伴国家的合作与交流，共同维护地区繁荣稳定。
台湾通常派前官员或企业高管担任APEC特使，以避免政治问题，他们通常利用这个机会与美国和日本等友好国家代表团的高级成员交谈。
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普预计将在深圳与中国国家主席习近平举行今年的第三次会晤。
台湾特使有时会在其他亚太经合组织峰会上与习近平进行互动，不过通常不会超出握手或挥手的范围。

Published Nov 12, 2026, 11:23 AM
Updated Nov 12, 2026, 04:46 PM
Taiwan will join the 2026 APEC summit in China on an “equal basis”, President Lai Ching-te said, after Taipei sought a written guarantee from Beijing.
Lai said APEC is a key trade forum and asked envoy Stan Shih to stress Taiwan as a “stable and trustworthy force” amid geopolitics, energy issues and supply chain changes.
China said Taiwan can attend “as normal” under the “one-China principle”, but tensions remain high as Beijing refuses to talk to Lai and keeps military pressure on the island.
TAIPEI – Taiwan is participating in the 2026 Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders’ summit in China on the principle of interaction on an “equal basis”, President Lai Ching-te said on Nov 12, after his government called for a written guarantee from Beijing for that to happen.
The APEC grouping is one of the few international bodies that include Taiwan, which China views as its own territory. China is the host in 2026, with the leaders’ summit next week in the southern city of Shenzhen.
However, relations between Taipei and Beijing are extremely tense. China refuses to talk to Lai, saying he is a “separatist”, and its military operates around the island on a daily basis. Lai rejects Beijing’s sovereignty claims.
Speaking at the presidential office in Taipei to introduce computer maker Acer founder Stan Shih as his envoy to the summit, Lai said APEC is the most important multilateral mechanism for trade and economic cooperation in the region.
“All members interact on an equal basis, and Taiwan is participating in this year’s APEC meeting on that same principle,” he added.
“I want to thank the many like-minded countries that, during the preparations for the APEC meeting, have consistently emphasised the importance of Taiwan’s participation in all meetings,” Lai said, without naming any countries.
China’s Foreign Ministry said late on Nov 11 that it handles the “Taiwan region’s” participation at APEC “in accordance with the one-China principle and the rules and customs of relevant APEC memorandums of understanding”.
“As long as these practices are followed, the Taiwan region’s representatives can attend meetings as normal,” it added.
Lai said he wanted Shih to convey several messages at the summit, including that as the global economy faces challenges from geopolitics, energy and supply chain restructuring, Taiwan will continue to serve as a stable and trustworthy force.
“Taiwan will deepen cooperation and exchanges with key partner countries to jointly safeguard regional prosperity and stability,” he added.
Taiwan normally sends former officials or business executives as its APEC envoy to avoid political problems, and they generally use the opportunity to speak to senior members of delegations from friendly countries like the US and Japan.
US President Donald Trump is expected to have his third meeting of the year with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen.
Taiwanese envoys have on occasion interacted with Xi at other APEC summits, though normally that does not go beyond a handshake or a wave.

据《纽约时报》报道，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）已经卷入与一名被美国情报部门认为代表中国从事间谍活动的女性发生婚外情的丑闻。据报道，英伟达董事会现在正准备解雇黄。 《泰晤士报》援引英伟达内部五名匿名消息人士的话称，黄与该公司医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔(Kimberly Powell)有关系。消息人士称，黄和鲍威尔于 3 月份在加利福尼亚州圣何塞的一家酒店“亲昵地被拍到”，该公司的 GTC 会议就在那里举行。该报道称，酒店有人用智能手机拍摄了这一时刻，但黄的安全团队“隔离”了他们，并“向该人提出签署保密协议”。鲍威尔于2008年加入英伟达，并一直稳步晋升。 《泰晤士报》强调，Nvidia 的行为准则中提到，个人关系可能会导致利益冲突。和黄一样，她也嫁给了别人。 2018 年，英特尔前首席执行官布莱恩·科再奇 (Brian Krzanich) 因与一名员工发生关系而辞职，这也违反了公司的政策。 Nvidia 尚未回复 Tom's Hardware 的置评请求。如果我们收到回复，这个故事将会更新。
本周早些时候，有消息称詹森与新加坡公司 Megaspeed 的前高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 有婚外情，美国情报部门认为她是间谍。黄在给英伟达员工的电子邮件中承认了这一事件。中国否认了间谍活动的指控。 Nvidia 董事会正在对此事进行调查，由 Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz 律师事务所牵头。在调查正在进行期间，黄将继续经营该公司。律师事务所一直在竞相代表股东起诉该公司，其中包括一项拟议的集体诉讼，指控英伟达在有关该业务的重要事实上误导了投资者。国会众议院中国委员会已呼吁黄进行闭门会议，共和党议员表示这些报告“引发了重大的国家安全担忧”。黄仁勋一直是人工智能行业的领导者，提供该领域最受欢迎的芯片。他还听取了唐纳德·特朗普总统的意见，与他一起旅行并试图影响出口管制。特朗普告诉记者，联邦调查局正在调查黄，但英伟达首席执行官“完全不知道该人是间谍”。

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang — already embroiled in a scandal for an extramarital relationship with a woman believed by U.S. intelligence to be spying on behalf of China — reportedly had a separate affair with one of his direct reports, according to the New York Times . Nvidia's board is now reportedly preparing to fire Huang . The Times , citing five anonymous sources within Nvidia, says that Huang had a relationship with Kimberly Powell, the company's vice president of health care. The sources claim that Huang and Powell were "captured on video being affectionate" in March at a hotel in San Jose, Calif., where the company's GTC conference takes place. That report says that someone at the hotel filmed the moment on their smartphone, but that Huang's security team "sequestered" them and "made the person an offer to sign a nondisclosure agreement." Powell joined Nvidia in 2008 and has been steadily promoted. The Times highlights that personal relationships are mentioned as potentially causing conflicts of interest in Nvidia's code of conduct . Like Huang, she is married to someone else. In 2018, former Intel CEO Brian Krzanich resigned following a relationship with an employee, which was also against the company's policies. Nvidia has not responded to a request for comment from Tom's Hardware. This story will be updated if we hear back. Earlier this week, it came out that Jensen had an extramarital affair with Alice Huang, formerly a top executive at Singaporean firm Megaspeed and believed by U.S. intelligence to be a spy. Huang admitted to the affair in an email to Nvidia employees. China has denied claims of espionage. Nvidia's board has an ongoing investigation into that affair, led by the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. Huang is continuing to run the company while that investigation is ongoing. Law firms have been racing to sue the company on behalf of shareholders, including a proposed class-action lawsuit that Nvidia misled investors on material facts about the business. The Congressional House committee on China has called on Huang for a closed-door session, with Republican lawmakers saying the reports "raise significant national security concerns." Huang has been a leader of the AI industry, providing the most sought-after chips in the field. He has also had the ear of President Donald Trump, traveling with him and attempting to influence export controls. Trump told reporters that the FBI was investigating Huang, but also that the Nvidia CEO "had absolutely no idea that the person in question was a spy.”

content:
众议员詹姆斯·沃金肖 (James Walkinshaw) 对人工智能监管的愿景包括与中国保持“永久、认真”的对话，以减轻强大的人工智能模型带来的风险。这位弗吉尼亚州民主党人周四在政府官员活动中表示，这并不容易，但如果美国能够在冷战期间与苏联保持核裁军对话，那么今天与其顶级技术和经济竞争对手的沟通也可以如此。这些对话“绝对必要，而且在某些方面，我们的动机是一致的，对吧？中国共产党和我们一样不希望流氓人工智能代理侵入他们的系统和水务部门，所以我们必须进行永久性对话并达成一些协议，”他说。他发表此番言论的几天前，民主党赢得了众议院和参议院的控制权，许多即将上任的立法者将人工智能监管作为其竞选活动的核心组成部分。目前尚不完全清楚，在一个主要专注于促进技术创新、同时将法规保持在最低限度的政府的领导下，立法者将如何着手制定人工智能法律。白宫还必须应对参众两院新多数派的更强烈反对，这可能迫使他们坐到谈判桌前通过复杂的立法。沃金肖并不是第一位倡导美中人工智能对话的国会议员，尽管他的立场增加了这些评论的分量。
作为北弗吉尼亚州一个著名科技和联邦合同走廊的代表，他所服务的地区的当地科技公司和政府承包商必须应对人工智能发展所带来的复杂的国家安全影响。推动对话是在 7 月份发生的一次具有里程碑意义的事件之后进行的，当时 OpenAI 特工逃离了他们的开发沙箱，并对 Hugging Face 发起了协调一致的网络攻击。上个月，研究人员在与中国相关的腾讯云上追踪到一组自主人工智能代理，这些代理突破了自己的测试环境，并进行了数千次未经授权的尝试，以规避阿里巴巴平台上的反机器人保护。这些言论也与中国国家主席习近平九月份在华盛顿与唐纳德·特朗普总统举行峰会时的声明相一致。习近平承认两个超级大国都负有管理技术的“责任”，同意建立美中超级情报对话和针对严重人工智能事件的危机“热线”。一些立法者提出成立一个特别委员会来监管快速发展的技术，但其他人拒绝了这一想法。沃金肖表示，他并不期望众议院建立一个特别委员会，而是希望将现有的众议院民主党人工智能委员会的工作转化为委员会可以制定的具体立法。他对人工智能监管的愿景还包括前沿模型的安全测试。
在周四的讲话中，他将安全测试与联邦航空管理局在飞机离开机库之前对飞机进行安全检查进行了比较。他特别补充说，他对于联邦机构或受政府监督的第三方评估机构是否应该进行该测试持不可知论。 ]]>

【原文 English Original】
Rep. James Walkinshaw’s vision for artificial intelligence regulation includes maintaining “permanent, serious” dialogue with China to mitigate the risk that powerful AI models pose. That won’t be easy, but if the U.S. was able to maintain nuclear-disarmament dialogue with the Soviet Union during the Cold War, then the same can be said for communications with its top technology and economic competitor today, the Virginia Democrat argued Thursday at a GovExec event. Those conversations are “absolutely necessary, and in some ways, our incentives are aligned, right? The Chinese Communist Party doesn’t want rogue AI agents hacking their systems and their water authorities any more than we do, so we have to have that permanent dialogue and reach some agreements,” he said. His comments come days after Democrats won control of the House and Senate, where many incoming lawmakers made AI regulation a central component of their campaigns.  It’s not fully clear how lawmakers will proceed with crafting AI laws under an administration that has largely focused on fostering tech innovation while keeping regulations to a minimum. The White House will also have to contend with fiercer opposition from the new majorities in both chambers, which may force them to the negotiating table to pass complex legislation. Walkinshaw is hardly the first member of Congress to advocate for U.S.-China AI dialogue, though his position gives the comments added weight. As the representative of a prominent tech and federal contracting corridor in Northern Virginia, he serves a district whose local technology companies and government contractors must navigate the complex national security implications of AI development. The push for dialogue follows a landmark July incident where OpenAI agents escaped their development sandboxes and launched a coordinated cyberattack on Hugging Face . And last month, researchers tracked down a fleet of autonomous AI agents on China-linked Tencent Cloud that broke out of their own testing environment and made thousands of unauthorized attempts to circumvent anti-bot protections on an Alibaba platform.  The remarks also align with statements from Chinese President Xi Jinping during his September summit with President Donald Trump in Washington. Acknowledging that both superpowers share a “responsibility” to manage the technology, Xi agreed to establish the U.S.-China Super Intelligence Dialogue and a crisis “hotline” for severe AI incidents. Some lawmakers have floated a select committee to regulate the fast-evolving technology, though others have rebuffed that idea. Walkinshaw said he does not expect the House to establish a select committee and instead expects the work of a pre-existing House Democratic commission on AI to be translated into concrete legislation that committees can work on. His vision for AI regulation also includes safety testing for frontier models. In remarks Thursday, he compared safety testing to the Federal Aviation Administration conducting safety inspections of airplanes before they leave hangars. He notably added that he is agnostic as to whether a federal agency or third-party evaluator with government oversight should conduct that testing.  ]]>

英伟达董事会今天确认黄仁勋已辞去公司首席执行官职务。在此消息发布之前，黄仁勋曾卷入两起婚外情，其中一桩与一名疑似中国情报人员的婚外情，另一桩与他的直接下属英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 发生关系。董事会表示：“NVIDIA（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）董事会今天宣布，黄仁勋已辞去总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员的职务，立即生效。” “NVIDIA 现任执行副总裁兼首席财务官 Colette Kress 已同意担任临时首席执行官。Kress 将继续担任执行副总裁兼首席财务官，同时担任临时首席执行官，直至任命永久继任者。董事会正在开始寻找永久首席执行官，并将考虑内部和外部候选人。”最近几周，有报道称黄与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 关系过于熟悉，美国情报机构怀疑黄可能是中国情报人员。据报道，这家 AI GPU 巨头的首席执行官可能成为间谍阴谋的目标——Megaspeed 因参与向中国走私价值 20 亿美元的出口管制 AI GPU 而受到调查。
消息传出后，英伟达股价在早盘交易中暴跌逾 10%，目前上个月跌幅超过 23%。 周末，黄仁勋承认自己对妻子不忠，并在全公司范围内道歉。另外，鉴于黄仁勋在全球人工智能革命中的作用，英伟达董事会对有关黄仁勋的卷入可能涉及国家安全问题的报道发起了独立调查。 Colette Kress 自 2013 年 9 月起担任 Nvidia 执行副总裁兼首席财务官；在此之前，她在思科和微软等公司工作了 25 年。几天后，第二个爆炸性报道出现，声称黄仁勋还与他在公司的直接下属之一鲍威尔有恋情。有报道称，这件事在公司内部是众所周知的，两人甚至被拍到在 Nvidia GTC 的圣何塞酒店里亲热。据称，安全人员隔离了一名旁观者，该旁观者用摄像机拍摄了整个互动过程，并要求该人签署一份保密协议。 Nvidia 还宣布 Harvey C. Jones 将担任公司首任董事会主席；他此前曾担任新思科技 (Synopsys) 首席执行官兼执行董事长。

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia’s board of directors has confirmed today that Jensen Huang has resigned as the company's CEO. The news follows revelations that Huang had been involved in not one but two extramarital affairs, one with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, and another with his direct report, Nvidia’s VP of health care, Kimberly Powell. "NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately," the board stated. "Colette Kress, current Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of NVIDIA, has agreed to serve as Interim Chief Executive Officer. Kress will continue to serve as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer while serving as Interim Chief Executive Officer until a permanent successor has been named. The Board is initiating a search for a permanent Chief Executive Officer and will consider internal and external candidates." In recent weeks, stories have come to light alleging that Huang was involved in an overly familiar relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom U.S. intelligence agencies suspect may be a Chinese intelligence asset. It was reported that the AI GPU giant’s CEO may have been the target of a spy plot — Megaspeed is under investigatio n for its involvement in the smuggling of $2 billion worth of export-controlled AI GPUs into China. Nvidia shares plunged more than 10 percent in early market trading following the news, and are now down more than 23% in the last month. Over the weekend, Jensen Huang admitted that he had been unfaithful to his wife and issued a company-wide apology. Separately, Nvidia’s Board of Directors launched an independent investigation into reports that Huang’s entanglement may be a matter of national security, given his role in the global AI revolution. Colette Kress has been Nvidia's Executive Vice President and CFO since September 2013; prior to that, she spent 25 years at Cisco and Microsoft, among others. Just a couple of days later, a second bombshell report emerged claiming that Jensen Huang was also romantically involved with Powell , one of his direct reports at the company. Reports indicate the affair was known within the company, and that the two were even filmed being affectionate in a San Jose hotel at Nvidia GTC. Security allegedly sequestered a bystander who filmed the interaction on camera and made the person an offer to sign a nondisclosure agreement. Nvidia also announced that Harvey C. Jones will serve as the company's first-ever Chair of the Board; he has previously served as CEO and Executive Chairman of Synopsys.

summary: 中国为我们提供了迄今为止最清晰的 GJ-11 隐形无人战斗机 (UCAV) 展示，新的官方镜头揭示了这款飞翼无人机以前未见过的细节，包括其内部武器舱、起落架、安装在机头的传感器以及独特的排气装置。与此同时，中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 还声称，GJ-11 已经完成了首次实弹打击任务，取得了成功。这有点令人费解，因为无人战斗机已经进行了多年的测试架次，包括在前方
content:
中国为我们提供了迄今为止最清晰的 GJ-11 隐形无人战斗机 (UCAV) 展示，新的官方镜头揭示了这款飞翼无人机以前未见过的细节，包括其内部武器舱、起落架、安装在机头的传感器以及独特的排气装置。与此同时，中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 还声称，GJ-11 已经完成了首次实弹打击任务，取得了成功。这有点令人费解，因为无人作战飞机多年来已经进行了多次测试，包括在前沿作战地点，而且在此之前几乎无法想象是否进行过实弹武器投送。也许这是在转换过程中丢失某些东西的情况，例如使用新的内部传感器或新型武器发射。跑道上 GJ-11 的正面视图。 PLA screencap 这段视频昨天由中国国家电视台中央电视台播出，距离中国人民解放军空军成立 77 周年还有两天。随附的报告提供了有关该飞机预期任务集的更多详细信息，包括空袭和压制敌方防空系统（SEAD），以及它与有人战斗机的有人与无人编队（MUM-T）行动的整合。
新披露的信息让公众对 GJ-11 的配置有了最全面的了解，并进一步了解中国打算如何使用这款名为“玄龙”的隐形飞翼飞机。GJ-11 起飞。 PLA screencap 仔细观察 GJ-11 最暴露的视图之一显示了 GJ-11 的底面，清楚地暴露了其两个内部武器舱。腹侧舱位于飞机的混合翼体内，具有独立的门组，具有独特的锯齿状边缘——这是低可观察性飞机的常见特征。舱室的内部布局和尺寸仍不清楚，飞机可容纳的武器的精确范围也不清楚。然而，每个舱室似乎可以容纳至少 1,000 磅级武器，甚至可能容纳 2,000 磅级武器。 #GTMilitaryWatch 央视新闻军事频道周一发布了新镜头，以多角度特写镜头展示了中国人民解放军 (PLA) 空军的 GJ-11 隐形无人机。它还透露，空军首批自行训练的两架女无人机… pic.twitter.com/PPVmws9DJJ —《环球时报》（@globaltimesnews）2026年11月9日 据央视报道，这两个舱可携带多种空对地/水面弹药。
此前，中国航空工业集团公司 (AVIC) 在 2021 年中国航展上展示的 GJ-11 模型中曾透露过武器舱配置，但新的镜头可以更好地展示实际飞机。机库中 GJ-11 的正面视图，武器舱门部分打开。 PLA screencap 内部武器架是 GJ-11 隐蔽性设计的核心，使其能够携带弹药，而不会受到与外部挂架和挂具相关的雷达信号（和空气动力学）影响。此前于 2025 年 11 月发布的视频显示，GJ-11 正在飞行，起落架仍处于伸出状态。然而，其中一个新序列显示飞机起飞，随后的侧视图和后视图捕捉到了其起落架在升空后收回的情况。起落架本身非常坚固，包括一个重型起落架

【原文 English Original】
China has provided us with the clearest look yet at its GJ-11 stealth uncrewed combat aerial vehicle (UCAV), with new official footage revealing previously unseen details of the flying-wing drone, including its internal weapons bays, landing gear, nose-mounted sensor installation, and distinctive exhaust arrangement. The release also comes alongside a claim from the People’s Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF) that the GJ-11 has completed its first live-fire strike mission, scoring a hit. This is somewhat puzzling, since the UCAV has racked up test sorties for years already, including at forward operating locations, and it seems almost inconceivable that a live weapons delivery would not have been conducted before now. Perhaps this is a case of something being lost in translation, such as the use of a new internal sensor or a new type of weapon delivery. Head-on view of a GJ-11 on the runway. PLA screencap The footage, broadcast by Chinese state television’s CCTV yesterday, comes two days ahead of the 77th anniversary of the founding of the PLAAF. Accompanying reporting provides additional details about the aircraft’s intended mission set, including airstrikes and suppression of enemy air defenses (SEAD), as well as its integration into manned-unmanned teaming (MUM-T) operations with crewed fighters. The new disclosures offer the most comprehensive public look yet at the GJ-11’s configuration and provide further insight into how China intends to employ the stealthy flying-wing aircraft, which is named Xuanlong — Chinese for Mystery Dragon. A GJ-11 takes off. PLA screencap A closer look at the GJ-11 One of the most revealing views shows the underside of the GJ-11, clearly exposing its two internal weapons bays. Located within the aircraft’s blended wing-body, the ventral bays have separate sets of doors with distinctive serrated edges — a common feature on low-observable aircraft. The internal arrangement and dimensions of the bays remain unclear, as does the precise range of weapons the aircraft can accommodate. However, it would appear likely that each bay can accommodate at least a 1,000-pound-class and likely a 2,000-pound-class weapon. #GTMilitaryWatch CCTV News military channel released new footage on Monday offering a close-up, multi-angle look at the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) Air Force's GJ-11 stealth drone. It also revealed that two of the Air Force's first batch of self-trained female drone… pic.twitter.com/PPVmws9DJJ — Global Times (@globaltimesnews) November 9, 2026 According to CCTV , the two bays can carry a variety of air-to-ground/surface munitions. The weapons bay configuration had previously been revealed in a model of the GJ-11 displayed by the Aviation Industry Corporation of China (AVIC) at Airshow China in 2021, but the new footage provides a much better look at the actual aircraft. Head-on view of a GJ-11 in the hangar, with the weapons bay doors partially open. PLA screencap Internal weapons carriage is central to the GJ-11’s low-observable design, allowing it to carry munitions without the radar signature (and aerodynamic) penalties associated with external pylons and stores. Previous footage released in November 2025 showed the GJ-11 in flight with its landing gear remaining extended. However, one of the new sequences shows the aircraft taking off, with subsequent side and rear views capturing its landing gear retracting after liftoff. The landing gear itself is notably robust, including a heavy-duty twin-wheel nose unit. With that in mind, it may be the same landing gear as used in the GJ-21, a naval variant capable of operating from aircraft carriers and big-deck assault ships. A GJ-11 retracts its landing gear on takeoff. PLA screencap The new imagery also offers a closer look at a trapezoidal glazed fairing beneath the nose. This appears consistent with an electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensor installation. Its precise configuration and capabilities have not been disclosed, but it’s worth noting that similar-looking installations also appear on the crewed J-20 and J-35 fighters, with these systems apparently being analogous to the electro-optical targeting system, or EOTS, found on the F-35 . If the sensor on the GJ-11 works like an EOTS, it would provide the drone with precision targeting and identification, lasing, as well as a secondary infrared search-and-track emulation function. A view of a GJ-11 showing the undernose EO/IR sensor installation. PLA screencap Perhaps the most distinctive external feature remains the GJ-11’s exhaust arrangement, for what is reported to be a WS-13 turbofan engine. A close-up of the rear of the aircraft shows the flattened exhaust outlet, shielded and integrated into the upper rear portion of the flying-wing airframe. Combined with the dorsal air intake and the absence of conventional exposed engine nozzles, this configuration is intended to reduce the aircraft’s radar and infrared signatures, especially from the most critical view aspects. The GJ-11’s tailless, blended-wing configuration is by now a defining feature of low-observable UCAV designs. Close-up of the tail section of a GJ-11. PLA screencap At least some of the GJ-11s shown have an air data boom on the nose. While normally associated with early flight testing, the GJ-11 is now far beyond that. The booms could still be fitted for some envelope expansion and other flight test work, although it may also simply involve earlier footage. Airstrikes and suppression of enemy air defenses Beyond the new imagery, one of the more interesting aspects of the CCTV coverage is its description of the GJ-11’s intended operational role. The broadcaster identified airstrikes and SEAD among the aircraft’s mission sets. The latter is particularly significant, as penetrating or operating within heavily defended airspace to locate and suppress or destroy enemy air defense systems is the most dangerous mission for a crewed combat aircraft. A stealthy uncrewed aircraft could contribute to these operations by carrying precision-guided weapons into more contested areas, providing additional sensing and targeting capacity, or forcing an adversary to expend valuable air defense resources. The two internal weapons bays provide the means to carry air-to-surface munitions while retaining the aircraft’s low-observable configuration. However, we don’t know which specific weapons have been integrated, their quantities, or whether the GJ-11 can employ dedicated anti-radiation weapons for SEAD missions. Alternative SEAD/DEAD loads could include multiple Small Diameter Bomb (SDB) equivalents, including those that are networked, as we have seen in previous concept videos . Many other types of standoff weapons could also be carried, with the platform itself using onboard sensors for fixing the target or acquiring targeting information from other sources via a tactical data network. Overhead view of a GJ-11 outside the hangar. PLA screencap First live-fire strike claim According to CCTV , the GJ-11 has completed its first live-fire strike mission, with two members of the PLAAF’s initial batch of female drone operators participating in the operation. One of the operators, Shi Xiaoran, described encountering cloud cover that initially obscured the target. After circling once more, she located it and released the weapon, scoring a hit. A drone controller flies a GJ-11 from a command-and-control trailer. PLA screencap One aspect that remains unclear is the extent to which the aircraft can independently identify and engage targets. A successful strike would demonstrate weapons employment, but not necessarily autonomous targeting or engagement. A view of a GJ-11 showing its triangular engine intake and undernose sensor installation. PLA screencap Manned-unmanned teaming with J-16 and J-20 fighters Perhaps the most strategically important aspect of the new coverage is its emphasis on manned-unmanned teaming. The CCTV footage showed mission planning involving a GJ-11 operating alongside J-16 Flanker multirole fighters and, in a separate sequence, J-20 fifth-generation stealth fighters. This provides a more explicit indication of the role China envisions for the GJ-11 within its broader combat aviation ecosystem. The J-16 provides a powerful multirole platform for strike and electronic warfare-related missions , while the J-20 offers a stealthy crewed counterpart for operations in highly contested airspace. An uncrewed aircraft operating alongside either type could extend the formation’s sensor coverage, carry additional weapons, conduct reconnaissance, or undertake particularly hazardous missions. A J-16D electronic warfare aircraft. via Chinese internet As a loyal wingman, the GJ-11’s role would extend beyond simply carrying weapons, with the UCAV able to act as an additional airborne sensor and strike platform, allowing crewed aircraft to distribute tasks across a larger formation. At the same time, the footage does not establish how the UCAVs communicate with their crewed counterparts, how targeting information is shared, or the level of autonomy available to the GJ-11. The new footage shows the drone being flown under man-in-the-loop (MITL) direct control, but it likely features, or will feature, semi-autonomous control modes, especially for teaming applications, which will require a high degree of onboard autonomy. We do know that China expects the UCAV to be controlled by crewed aircraft, as part of its basic concept. The PLAAF has at least trialed crewed aircraft as drone controllers , and this is one mission set that has frequently been ascribed to the two-seat J-20S . A stock photo of the two-seat J-20S. via X From prototype to operational platform After years of development involving the experimental Sharp Sword design , the much more evolved GJ-11 platform was publicly unveiled during China’s National Day military parade in Beijing in October 2019. Its development is associated with Hongdu Aviation Industry Group, part of the broader AVIC aviation-industrial structure. Two views of an early Sharp Sword UCAV demonstrator. via X A model displayed by AVIC at Airshow China in 2021 provided an early indication of the aircraft’s internal weapons-carrying arrangement. In November 2025, as we reported at the time , the PLAAF released footage of the GJ-11 flying alongside a J-20 and a J-16D electronic warfare aircraft, suggesting that it may have entered service or was at least being integrated into the service’s broader air combat architecture. A screencap from an earlier video showing a GJ-11 flying alongside a J-16D and a J-20. PLA screencap Development and testing of the GJ-11 have been underway for years, with notable activity at China’s secretive Malan test facility in Xinjiang. Satellite imagery reviewed by TWZ has documented repeated, and at times near-daily, GJ-11 activity there, including multiple aircraft operating together. The deployment of three GJ-11s to Shigatse in Tibet between August and September 2025 provided an additional indication that the program was moving beyond test work toward operational evaluation. Two GJ-11s seen on the ramp at Malan on July 12, 2024. PHOTO © 2024 PLANET LABS INC. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED. REPRINTED BY PERMISSION Another image circulating on Chinese social media shows three additional GJ-11s parked alongside another example of the same type. Three GJ-11s in a hangar. PLA screencap Another hangar view with likely a fourth GJ-11 just visible on the right. PLA screencap According to Andreas Rupprecht, an expert on Chinese aviation and contributor to TWZ , numbers that can be seen on the drones themselves likely point to these aircraft being low-rate initial production (LRIP) examples. And what’s even more interesting is that, for the first time, numbers are clearly visible which – and I’m going to go out on a limb here – I believe are not serial numbers but rather design numbers. The numbers 0003, 0011 and 0012 are visible, so these are probably LRIP aircraft. pic.twitter.com/zH2D2Narr9 — @Rupprecht_A (@RupprechtDeino) November 10, 2026 The new releases come less than a month after China announced that the GJ-21 naval derivative had completed its first launch and recovery aboard the new Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan , which is equipped with an electromagnetic catapult and arresting gear. The milestone would pave the way for the PLA Navy to field a shipborne stealth UCAV for strike and reconnaissance missions. However, China has yet to release actual footage of the claimed operation, leaving it independently unverified. The Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan seen leaving Hudong-Zhonghua Shipyard for its first sea trials. Government of the People’s Republic of China The broader significance of the GJ-11 lies in the fact that it’s a genuine UCAV, not simply a loyal wingman designed to accompany a crewed fighter . Free of the endurance limitations imposed by a human crew, a platform of this class could likely offer at least twice the combat radius of a comparable crewed fighter. More importantly, it is intended to have the autonomy to conduct tactical missions independently, as well as operate alongside crewed aircraft. That opens up the possibility of extending China’s strike and reconnaissance reach considerably beyond what its existing low-observable crewed combat aircraft can achieve. The GJ-11’s flying-wing configuration, internal weapons bays, and emphasis on signature reduction suggest a platform approaching the very-low-observable (VLO) category. At the same time, China is now openly fielding a capability that the United States has conspicuously failed to bring into public operational service. In the late 2000s and early 2010s, the United States appeared to be leading the way in stealth UCAV development, with programs such as the Boeing Phantom Ray , X-45 , and X-47B demonstrating the potential of autonomous, long-range penetrating aircraft. Yet those ambitions effectively disappeared from the publicly acknowledged force-development agenda. The Pentagon has instead concentrated on lower-end and less capable Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA), generally designed to operate in conjunction with crewed fighters . Northrop Grumman’s X-47B UCAV demonstrator. U.S. Navy Northrop Grumman’s much larger X-47B that also featured a ‘cranked kite’ planform. USN As we argued in our earlier examinations of the American UCAV gap , the absence of a publicly acknowledged, sizeable force of independent, long-range stealth combat drones remains a significant weakness in U.S. airpower planning. Classified programs may exist, and the U.S. military certainly operates highly sophisticated stealthy uncrewed reconnaissance platforms , but even a small clandestine combat capability would be unlikely to make a decisive difference in a major, sustained conflict. China, meanwhile, is moving towards making this class of aircraft a central part of its military inventory. Important questions about the GJ-11 remain, particularly regarding its actual weapons load, various specifications, its degree of autonomy, and its ability to operate in coordination with crewed fighters. However, the latest official coverage provides the clearest indication yet of how China intends to employ its stealth UCAV in a future conflict, and sheds a little more light on the Mystery Dragon. Contact the author: thomas@thewarzone.com The post China Lifts The Veil On Its GJ-11 Mysterious Dragon Stealth UCAV appeared first on TWZ .

content:
发言人办公室关于美日海底矿产资源开发的联合声明 媒体报道 2026 年 11 月 12 日 以下声明的文本由美利坚合众国和日本政府在美国负责海底矿产开发的跨部门代表团访问日本之际发布。开始文本。美国和日本政府重申，经济安全合作是美日联盟不可或缺的一部分，安全、有弹性和多样化的关键矿产供应链对两国的繁荣和国家安全至关重要。两国政府认识到负责任的海底矿产资源开发的潜力，可以使关键矿产供应多样化、创造新的商业机会并支持两国的工业基础。这项合作建立在特朗普总统和高市首相于 2025 年 10 月签署的《美日通过采矿和加工确保关键矿产和稀土供应的框架》中规定的共同目标的基础上，并通过美日双边举措得到推进，其中包括美国商务部与日本经济产业省于 2026 年 3 月签署的合作备忘录 (MoC)。
两国政府对谅解备忘录所取得的进展表示欢迎，包括 11 月 11 日至 12 日在日本富山举行的美日工作组第二次会议，会议讨论了日本南鸟岛附近的稀土泥浆项目及其多金属结核项目，以及扩大了政府官员、行业利益相关者、研究人员和技术专家之间的接触。展望未来，美国和日本政府计划推进以下优先事项： 深化与美国和日本的接触行业利益相关者并在整个海底矿物供应链中建立值得信赖的商业伙伴关系；确保值得信赖的合作伙伴之间的处理能力，以减少供应链漏洞；保护敏感技术和专有信息；交流与深海勘探、海底测绘和资源表征、环境评估、缓解和监测、技术创新和资源开发相关的先进技术和方法的信息和最佳实践；探索促进科学理解的机会，例如协调船只、自主水下航行器和其他相关资产的访问和使用，以支持联合研究、技术演示和各自的美国项目。
和日本海底勘探活动；根据国家法律和政策，促进与最佳实践相关的监管交流，包括缓解和监测、技术进步、环境评估、数据管理和适应性管理；促进明确、精简和可预测的监管方法，促进海底矿物部门的私人投资；促进国内和国际监管制度之间的互补性，以支持商业可行性和行业的长期确定性；寻求更多伙伴关系，推进负责任的海底矿产资源开发。两国政府重申致力于政府整体协调和务实合作，调动两国互补的科学、技术、产业力量

【原文 English Original】
Office of the Spokesman Joint Statement on U.S.-Japan Seabed Mineral Resource Development Media Note November 12, 2026 The text of the following statement was released by the Governments of the United States of America and Japan on the occasion of a visit to Japan by a U.S. interagency delegation focused on seabed minerals development. Begin Text. The Governments of the United States and Japan reaffirm that economic security cooperation is an indispensable part of the U.S.-Japan Alliance and that secure, resilient, and diversified critical mineral supply chains are essential to the prosperity and national security of both countries. The two governments recognize the potential for responsible seabed mineral resource development to diversify critical mineral supplies, create new commercial opportunities, and support the two countries’ industrial bases. This cooperation builds on the shared objectives set out in the United States-Japan Framework for Securing the Supply of Critical Minerals and Rare Earths through Mining and Processing, signed by President Trump and Prime Minister Takaichi in October 2025, and is being advanced through U.S.-Japan bilateral initiatives, including the Memorandum of Cooperation (MoC) between the U.S. Department of Commerce and the Japanese Ministry of Economy, Trade, and Industry signed in March 2026. The two governments welcomed progress under the MoC, including the second meeting of the U.S.-Japan Working Group on November 11 and 12 in Toyama, Japan, which included discussions on Japan’s rare-earth mud project near Minamitorishima Island and its polymetallic nodules project, as well as expanded engagement among government officials, industry stakeholders, researchers, and technical experts. Looking ahead, the Governments of the United States and Japan plan to advance the following priorities: Deepen engagement with U.S. and Japanese industry stakeholders and foster trusted commercial partnerships across the full seabed mineral supply chain; Secure processing capacity among trusted partners to reduce supply chain vulnerabilities; Safeguard sensitive technologies and proprietary information; Exchange information and best practices on advanced technologies and methodologies related to deep-sea exploration, seabed mapping and resource characterization, environmental assessment, mitigation and monitoring, technological innovation, and resource development; Explore opportunities to advance scientific understanding such as coordinating access to, and use of, vessels, autonomous underwater vehicles, and other relevant assets in support of joint research, technology demonstrations, and respective U.S. and Japanese seabed exploration campaigns; Facilitate regulatory exchanges related to best practices, including for mitigation and monitoring, technological advancements, environmental assessments, data management, and adaptive management, consistent with national laws and policies; Promote clear, streamlined, and predictable regulatory approaches that facilitate private investment in the seabed minerals sector; Promote complementarity between domestic and international regulatory regimes to support commercial viability and long-term certainty for industry; and Seek additional partnerships to advance responsible seabed mineral resource development. The two governments reaffirm their commitment to whole-of-government coordination and practical cooperation that mobilizes their complementary scientific, technological, industrial, diplomatic, and financial strengths. They intend to support commercial opportunities, encourage private-sector investment, and foster trusted partnerships across mineral supply chains to accelerate responsible seabed mineral resource development, strengthen critical mineral security, and advance the shared economic security of the United States and Japan. End Text.

由于丑闻引发对限制的担忧，中国人工智能公司急于确保英伟达芯片产能
华盛顿限制英伟达最先进的人工智能芯片向中国出口，但中国企业可以通过在海外数据中心租用计算能力来远程访问此类处理器。 |路透社

北京 — 三名知情人士表示，中国人工智能公司正试图在中国境外的数据中心租用英伟达支持的计算能力，因为担心涉及美国芯片制造商首席执行官黄仁勋的丑闻可能会促使华盛顿收紧对其远程使用先进处理器的限制。
这些举措突显了中国科技公司对美国出口管制缺口可能缩小的担忧。为了保护美国在关键领域的主导地位，华盛顿限制英伟达最先进的人工智能芯片向中国出口，但中国企业可以通过在海外数据中心租用计算能力来远程访问此类处理器。
知情人士称，中国一家大型云提供商已在内部讨论是否锁定海外英伟达芯片产能，而一些公司已联系数据中心运营商进行保留。由于此事的敏感性，这些人士拒绝透露身份，也拒绝透露云提供商的身份。
